items.reason: Detention of Vietnamese (with Thai, Cambodian, Myanmar) fishermen in the Natuna Sea/Karimata waters has nothing comparable in 2000 (no candidates) or in 1999, whose record (prev-run candidate ev-4d5b0cdec2) shows only the Natuna Regency law; the practice last seen in 1991 (ev-11f379bf83) is new again. Provisional on 2000 being genuinely empty, and most of those held were non-claimant crews.

Mass seizures of Thai and Vietnamese boats in Pejantan/Karimata/Natuna waters, incl. a third Operasi Karimata, continue at the same level the 2001 practice of ev-59b17deec7 (two mass seizures that year too); provisional until 2001 is decided.

PP 38/2002 restates the archipelagic base points and folds in the 1998 Natuna-only regulation (ev-c7a0d24a85), a law in force throughout 2001; nothing comparable in the 2001 record, but a restatement is maintenance. Settled by whether the 2002 Natuna base points differ from (extend) those of PP 61/1998.

A fleet commander's threat to fire on foreign violators would be a new method against the 2002 seizures (ev-fddacb9915), but it was prompted by sinking Thai boats in the Gelasa Strait, outside the South China Sea dispute, and names no claimant; likely reject unless a source ties the warning to the Natuna waters or rival claimants' vessels.

A 4,000-strong fleet exercise with naval combat drills in the Natuna Sea has nothing comparable in the 2003 record (only the threat ev-11ee0efd6f); the last such Natuna exercise found was 1996 (ev-80d2f0ea55), so it is new again. A coder may know Armada Jaya as a recurring exercise and check whether 2003's was also held in the Natuna Sea.

Permanent court confiscation and redistribution of 16 seized Thai and Vietnamese boats to local fishermen is a change of method (punishment beyond detention) with nothing comparable in 2003 and harsher than the 2002 seizures ev-fddacb9915; low confidence since the number of Vietnamese boats and the place of seizure are not given.

Seizure of three Vietnamese boats in Natuna waters continues the seizure-and-confiscation practice the 2004 record shows (ev-cdd40a3eca), with no change of method or area; provisional until 2004 is decided.

The 2005-2006 arrests of Vietnamese crews in Natuna/Pontianak/Pemangkat waters continue the 2004 practice of ev-cdd40a3eca; no count is given, and by the DKP's own account any rise reflects Vietnamese boats newly arriving from 2006 (Chubb's counterfactual), not a change of method.

Seizing a Vietnamese cargo ship smuggling sugar is customs/anti-smuggling enforcement, not an assertion of the claim; likely reject, unless the seizure point was in the disputed EEZ rather than Indonesia's archipelagic or territorial waters.

A presidential visit to the Natuna Islands stressing that outer islands must be safeguarded has nothing comparable in the 2005 record (only fisheries seizures ev-fa327c4f28, ev-1fd25090cc); low confidence, as the visit was a stopover en route to APEC in Hanoi and names no rival.

Seizure of four Vietnamese boats and 125 crew off Tarempa continues the 2006 practice in ev-1fd25090cc (2005-2006 arrests); the DKP says Vietnamese boats are newcomers since 2006, so more seizures reflect more boats, not a change of method (Chubb's counterfactual). Provisional.

Designating the Natuna Sea a priority area for a large-scale anti-illegal-fishing campaign with the Navy is a declarative assertion of jurisdiction with nothing comparable in 2006 (the visit ev-dbad155a5b is a different act); low confidence, as a coder may treat it as routine policy announcement.

Seizure of 17 Vietnamese, Chinese and Taiwanese boats in the Natuna EEZ, with diplomatic notes to all three, extends enforcement to Chinese and Taiwanese vessels, against 2007's Vietnamese-only seizures (ev-ce262c6747). Check Chubb's counterfactual: if Chinese boats simply appeared for the first time, it is a continuation.

Seizure of two Malaysian pair trawlers in Natuna waters on 22 April 2008 is part of the same extension of fisheries enforcement to other claimants' vessels as ev-e15b562893 (same month, same DKP patrols); 2007 shows only Vietnamese seizures.

The DKP's public threat to shoot fleeing poachers and sink their boats as 'a show of force' is a new method (a threat of punishment) against 2007's seizures (ev-ce262c6747) and announcement (ev-869335de93); it is national in scope, with the Natuna Sea as the example.

The first TNI joint exercise in 12 years, rehearsing the recapture of Natuna by amphibious landing and paratroops, has nothing comparable in 2007; the 2004 Armada Jaya exercise (ev-7d76d254ae) was absent in 2007, so this is new again.
Seizure of four Vietnamese (and five Thai) boats in the Natuna EEZ continues at the same level the 2007 Vietnamese-boat seizures of ev-ce262c6747; provisional.
A warship's seizure of three Vietnamese trawlers held at Ranai continues the 2007 practice of ev-ce262c6747 (seizure of Vietnamese boats in Natuna/Anambas waters); provisional.

Law 43/2008 on State Territory, defining Indonesia's waters and jurisdiction zones and allowing unilateral limits where no neighbour borders them, is a new legislative assertion with nothing comparable in 2007; low confidence, as it is a national framework law that does not single out the South China Sea.

Declaring the ExxonMobil D-Alpha contract lapsed and assigning the block to Pertamina is a domestic contract decision with a US company; nothing comparable in 2008. Settled by whether the decision was presented as asserting control over the block against China's claim (Kalla's 9 February 'no country can intervene' remark points that way).
Seizure of a Taiwanese longliner off Ranai continues the 2008 seizures of Taiwanese boats in ev-e15b562893 at the same level; provisional.
Seizure of a Vietnamese purse seiner in the Indonesian EEZ continues the 2008 seizures of Vietnamese boats (ev-c30e71a054); provisional.

Chinese boats were already among those seized in 2008 (ev-e15b562893), so seizing eight Chinese trawlers is the same practice; the coder should check whether 5 N 110 E is further out than the 2008 seizures (a scope move) and whether eight is more than 2008's Chinese share.

Publicly rejecting China's protest that the seizure area was open sea, and insisting on prosecution, is a new verbal assertion against China's claim; the 2008 record shows only diplomatic notes asking for detainee verification (ev-e15b562893).
The ambassador's refusal in Beijing of China's demand to release the 77 fishermen is the same rejection of China's protest over the June seizure as ev-8356b4f7df.

Depositing the archipelagic baseline coordinates, including the Natuna base points, with the UN is a submission to an international authority, with nothing comparable in 2008 (Law 43, ev-e5f5cfa5e2, is domestic); low confidence, as it is a routine UNCLOS art. 47(9) obligation.

Detaining Vietnamese black-coral divers off Tambelan continues the 2008 practice of detaining Vietnamese crews (ev-c30e71a054), by a local joint team rather than the Navy or DKP; provisional, and marginal as a state act and as a South China Sea location.
